title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
abstract: arXiv:2610.35439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. translated_title: Omni-InteractScope：面向连续全模态流的主动式智能体交互基准测试
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型日益被期望在观察连续视听流的同时为用户提供辅助。然而，现有评估对于这些模型如何可靠地将流证据和用户需求关联为及时、持续的干预所提供的洞察十分有限。我们提出了 Omni-InteractScope，这是一个包含 1,479 条经人工标注并交叉审核的交互、横跨八个任务组共 1,790 个时间目标的基准。该基准将输入模态、事件触发、干预类型和用户需求相互关联，涵盖基于事件时机的工具调用与无需查询的主动辅助，以及通知、警告、状态跟踪和连续响应等任务。我们在该基准上的实验结果揭示了当前全模态大语言模型的三个关键局限：(1) 及时的工具调用仍然不可靠：所有 12 个被评估模型最多只能对 40% 的工具调用目标给出准时的首次响应，且联合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 Omni-InteractScope 基准，通过 1,479 条人工标注交互系统评估全模态大模型在连续全模态流中的主动式智能体交互能力，并揭示其在及时工具调用等方面的关键局限。
en_tdlr: Introduces Omni-InteractScope, a benchmark with 1,479 human-annotated interactions for evaluating proactive and agentic interaction of Omni-LLMs in continuous omnimodal streams, revealing critical limitations such as unreliable timely tool invocation.
